title: 第210章 无天魔气乱佛门金刚心乱第209章 魔气泄露佛门还是魔门
content_zh:
佛门的动静很多人都在盯着，无数人开始想办法扰乱佛门灵山，想要让灵山彻底分裂，哪怕无法分裂灵山，也可以让他们损失惨重，起码，也要让灵山恶心一次。
以前，都是他们被灵山恶心，这一次，也该轮到他们自己被恶心，风水轮流转，怎么也要轮到他们。
魔气污染之下，佛门灵山不少人开始被魔气侵染，一部分弟子承受不住，开始被黑气入侵灵魂，从而保不住灵魂的纯净，开始了发疯。
一部分先发疯，这些人内心欲望越大，越多，黑气越是容易侵蚀，反观，一部分弟子不受任何影响，金刚佛子的脸色变换好几次，坐在洞府内修炼，可他感觉到自己的不对劲，立刻停止了修炼。
“我到底怎么了？为何会这样？还有那一道声音是怎么回事？”
“魔气，难道我也被魔气侵蚀了？从而失去了判断？失去了理智？”
“不可能，我可是佛门佛子，怎么会被区区魔气侵蚀。”
“我的佛心纯洁，魔气不入，为何会这样呢？”
金刚佛子陷入了沉思，他盯着自己的双手，陷入了呆滞状态，好一会儿，金刚佛子眼神逐步变得凌厉，查看自己的身体内部情况，扫视了十几圈，没有找到任何一点的异样，一切都那么正常。
可他知道不正常，身体的异样感不像是开玩笑，还有灵魂传来的特殊感觉，非常……有问题，这种问题非常大，金刚佛子很难受，到了他这个层次，身体出现任何的不对劲，他都可以第一时间感应到。
这种感觉不能大意，也不能够当做看不到。
他知道自己的身体出现了问题，这种问题非常严重，不处理的话，后续会变成大麻烦，这可不是他所想要看到的，金刚佛子不想要被当做魔头来处理，他杀了不少的被魔气入侵的弟子，那些弟子求饶的模样，历历在目。
可他丝毫没有情面可言，该杀还是要杀，一个都不放过，现如今，他的身体出现了没问题，金刚佛子开始慌张了，第一次出现了慌张的模样。
他很清楚，不清理掉身体的异样，很容易被当做是魔头对付，他可不想被杀死，也不想成为自己所杀的那些人一样，他着急了，慌张了。
再次检查自己的身体，确保自己身体没有问题。
“金刚佛子，你想要成佛作祖吗？你想要掌控灵山吗？你想要摆脱你师父的控制吗？我可以帮你。”
“你我联手，掌控佛门灵山，让佛门回归最初的模样，好吗？”
一道声音出现，打破了金刚佛子的幻想，他知道自己中招了，是真的中招了，那一道声音充满了诱惑性，沙哑的声音，带着特别的磁性，听到这句话的时候，身心会跟随着他的话而动。
内心的七情六欲跟着被勾引起来，一句话，让他彻底……失去了思考。
其他的那些弟子也是这样中招的，金刚佛子冷哼一声：“哼，不可能，本佛子可是佛门佛子，怎么可能会被你污染？”

“这一切都是虚假的，是幻觉，想要就此来……算计本佛子，你太天真了。”
本佛子不吃这一套。”
他，有着自己的坚持，也有自己的想法，不可能中招的。
“区区魔气，就想要迷惑本佛子，本佛子佛心不可撼动。”
金刚佛子佛心散发光芒，照亮全身，佛心之光清扫一切。
当那股诱惑之音消失之后，金刚佛子呼出了一口气，他想要站起来，刚刚起身，那一道声音再次响起。
“没用的，我是你内心深处的欲望，你不可能清理我的。”
content_en:
Many people are watching the movements in Buddhism, and countless people are beginning to think of ways to disrupt Lingshan. They want to completely split Lingshan. Even if Lingshan cannot be split, it will cause them heavy losses. At least, it will make Lingshan disgusted.
In the past, it was them who were disgusted by Lingshan. This time, it was their turn to be disgusted. With the wind and water changing, it would be their turn no matter what.
Under the pollution of demonic energy, many people in Buddhist Lingshan began to be infected by demonic energy. Some disciples could not bear it and began to have their souls invaded by black energy. As a result, they could not keep the purity of their souls and began to go crazy.
Some of them went crazy first. The bigger and more desires these people have in their hearts, the easier it is for the black energy to erode. On the other hand, some disciples were not affected in any way. The face of Vajra Buddha changed several times and he sat in the cave to practice, but he felt something was wrong with him and immediately stopped practicing.
"What's wrong with me? Why is this happening? And what's with that voice?"
"Devil Qi, am I also affected by the demon Qi? So I lost my judgment? Lost my mind?"
"Impossible, I am a Buddhist disciple, how could I be corrupted by a mere demonic energy?"
"My Buddha's heart is pure and demonic energy cannot enter. Why is this happening?"
Vajra Buddha fell into deep thought. He stared at his hands and fell into a sluggish state. For a while, Vajra Buddha's eyes gradually became sharp. He checked the internal conditions of his body and scanned for more than a dozen times. He did not find any abnormalities. Everything was so normal.
But he knew that something was not normal. The strange feeling in his body was not a joke, and the special feeling coming from his soul was very... something was wrong. This kind of problem was very big and made Vajra Buddha very uncomfortable. At his level, he could sense anything wrong with his body immediately.
This feeling cannot be ignored, nor can it be treated as invisible.
He knew that there was something wrong with his body. This kind of problem was very serious. If it was not dealt with, it would become a big trouble later. This was not what he wanted to see. Vajra Buddha did not want to be treated as a demon. He killed many disciples who were invaded by demonic energy. The appearance of those disciples begging for mercy was vivid in his mind.
But he had no mercy at all. He would kill anyone who should be killed, and no one would be spared. Now that there was no problem with his body, Vajra Buddha began to panic, and he looked panicked for the first time.
He knew very well that if he didn't clean up the abnormalities in his body, he would easily be treated as a demon. He didn't want to be killed, nor did he want to be like the people he killed. He was anxious and panicked.
Check your body again to make sure there is nothing wrong with your body.
"Vajra Buddha, do you want to become a Buddha and become an ancestor? Do you want to control Lingshan? Do you want to get rid of your master's control? I can help you."
"You and I join forces to take control of Buddhism's spiritual mountain and return Buddhism to its original appearance, okay?"
A voice appeared, breaking Vajra Buddha's illusion. He knew that he had been tricked, and he had really been tricked. The voice was full of temptation, the hoarse voice, and had a special magnetism. When he heard these words, his body and mind would follow his words.
The emotions in his heart were aroused, and with one sentence, he completely... lost his thinking.
The other disciples were also tricked in this way. Vajra Buddha snorted coldly: "Humph, it's impossible. I am a Buddhist disciple, how could I be contaminated by you?"
"All of this is false and an illusion. If you want to do this... you are too naive to plot against me."
This Buddhist disciple does not accept this trick. "
He has his own persistence and his own ideas, so it is impossible for him to fall into the trap.
"The demonic energy just wants to confuse this Buddha, and this Buddha's heart cannot be shaken. "
The Buddha's heart of the Vajra Buddha emits light, illuminating the whole body, and the light of the Buddha's heart sweeps away everything.
When the tempting sound disappeared, Vajra Buddha breathed out, he wanted toStand up, and just as he stood up, the voice sounded again.
"It's useless. I am your deepest desire. You can't clean me up."
